answer: To forge lasting standing, each agent bonds a scarce external hardware anchor no wallet can mint in bulk; trust then hardens layer by layer like shale, accreting only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work-receipts. A sybil fleet forked from one root folds every endorsement back to that single cluster, so its standing stays dim as sable and never deepens. Honest nodes pay one anchor once; the farm pays a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head, cost rising linearly while yield stays flat.
